description: This header file defines interfaces and classes for managing F1-U gateway bearers in the CU-UP component, including notifier classes, bearer creation, and UDP gateway specifics.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_gateway_bearer_rx_notifier
classes.description: Interface for a notifier that handles new PDU events for the RX bearer.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_gateway_bearer
classes.description: Interface for an F1-U gateway bearer, including stop and get_bind_address methods.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_gateway
classes.description: Main class for managing F1-U CU-UP gateways, including creating bearers and attaching TEID info.

classes.name: f1u_cu_up_udp_gateway
classes.description: Specialized UDP implementation of the F1-U CU-UP gateway.

methods.name: create_cu_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new CU bearer with specified parameters including UE index, S-NSSAI, DRB ID, Five Qi, config, TEID, notifier, and executor.

methods.name: attach_dl_teid
methods.description: Attaches downlink TEID information to the gateway.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address of the gateway.

methods.name: get_bind_port
methods.description: Returns the bind port for UDP gateway.
